task: Issue #562: the portal certificate renew grant (certificates/status update) was cluster-wide in ClusterRole narwhal-portal. Narrow it to the namespaces that hold Certificates.

events.summary: Move only the certificates/status update grant from the ClusterRole to per-namespace Roles + RoleBindings. Nothing is widened: same verb and subresource, same single subject, fewer namespaces. Deliberately left alone: cluster-wide read of certificates/clusterissuers, the renew implementation and route (path is already namespaced), portal image pin, live cluster (read-only get only), Gitea.

kubectl --context narwhal get certificates -A lists 4 Certificates in 3 namespaces: devtools/narwhal-portal-valkey-tls, platform-system/narwhal-root-ca and narwhal-wildcard-tls, storage/openbao-tls. renewCertificate in portal/src/lib/k8s-client.ts PUTs /apis/cert-manager.io/v1/namespaces/<ns>/certificates/<name>/status, so a namespaced Role suffices; the route already maps k8s 403 to a clear error.

D-CERT-RENEW-NS: removed the certificates/status rule from ClusterRole narwhal-portal; added Role+RoleBinding narwhal-portal-cert-renew in devtools, platform-system and storage granting only update on certificates/status to ServiceAccount devtools/narwhal-portal. Comment in k8s-client.ts updated; no behavior change.
